description: This file imports styling resources, including the 'unsafeCSS' function from the 'lit' library and 'structuralStyles' from a relative path, then creates and exports a constant 'structuralStyles' that applies these styles using 'unsafeCSS'. The content indicates it is a style module used in conjunction with Lit-based components.
